intro.title: Navgraha (9 planets) Pujas
intro.description: Online Navagraha rituals dedicated to the nine Vedic planets, intended to ease difficulties that arise when planetary positions in a birth chart are unfavourable. As a long-established puja service, we arrange Nakshatra rites, Kumbha Vivah, Mangal and Shani observances, and other planetary ceremonies. Learned priests trained in the Kashi Gurukul tradition perform each rite in our temple, following classical Vedic guidelines with care.
